# A Potential Trend Change for Liquidity

Report 112 | Published 2023-06-11 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2023-6-11/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/112.json)

Liquidity caution alongside selective equities.

The three-year Bitcoin direction succeeded, and the BLDR and short-window Adobe observations are reproducible. The September hedge expired out of the money if held, while its actual cost is unavailable. Liquidity direction and stock direction diverged. Legal analysis needs transaction-level nuance and later policy reversals; long business theses retain their actual horizons.

**Coverage:** All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

## Claims

### 112-C01

**Emergency loans need QE**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Mixed |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | 2023-bank-support-forces-qt-end |
| Source blocks | 14, 19 |
| Thesis family | 2023-bank-support-forces-qt-end |

The base case failed as new BTFP lending ended March 2024 while QT continued into 2025. The report explicitly identified the alternative that did occur: bill issuance financed from falling RRP. Credit that falsifier without counting the failed base case as a win.

**Direction:** Not independently resolved; see rationale.

**Timing:** No numerical deadline was stated.

**Mechanism:** A matching outcome alone does not establish causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [BTFP lending cessation](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20240124a.htm) | Federal Reserve | 2024-01-24 | Verified in the audit

New BTFP loans stopped March 11, 2024; discount window remained available; rate floor adjusted to reserve-interest rate.

- [Monetary policy implementation](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/speech/jefferson20260116a.htm) | Federal Reserve | 2026-01-16 | Verified in the audit

Balance-sheet runoff begun in 2022 ended December 2025; reserve-management purchases followed. This was more than two years after March 2023 stress.

- [ON RRP declines and bills](https://www.kansascityfed.org/research/economic-bulletin/rapid-declines-in-the-feds-overnight-reverse-repurchase-on-rrp-facility-may-start-to-slow/) | Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City | 2023-11-10 | Verified in the audit

Bill issuance after the debt-limit agreement drew money-fund cash from ON RRP into the TGA; higher relative bill yields attracted allocations.

## Analytical tools and charts

- **Net liquidity:** Funding offsets Visual inspection: not performed.
- **PMI:** Fiscal-credit balance Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Valuation charts:** Selection and sizing Visual inspection: not performed.

## Framework lessons

- Use cash, businesses and scarcity for different risks.

## Verification limitations

- Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
- Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
- Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
